votes.motion: Approve work session minutes of June 12, 2023 and July 13, 2023 as well as the formal meeting minutes of July 11, 2023; July 13, 2023; July 18, 2023 and August 8, 2023.
votes.description: The Council approved several prior work session and formal meeting minutes from June, July, and August 2023.

votes.motion: Adopt Joint Ceremonial Resolution 26 of 2023 with Mayor Mendenhall declaring the second Monday in October as Indigenous Peoples Day in Salt Lake City.
votes.description: The Council and Mayor jointly declared the second Monday in October as Indigenous Peoples Day in Salt Lake City.

votes.motion: Adopt Joint Ceremonial Resolution 27 of 2023 with Mayor Mendenhall declaring November as Native American Heritage Month in Salt Lake City.
votes.description: The Council and Mayor jointly declared November as Native American Heritage Month in Salt Lake City.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer the budget amendment and two grants to a future date for action.
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on Budget Amendment No. 2 for FY2023-24 and two Fire Department grant applications, deferring action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting on the rezone and master plan amendment at approximately 1435 South State Street.
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on the proposed rezone and master plan amendment for properties at 1433/1435 South State Street and related parcels, deferring final action.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a later date on the Anti-Gentrification and -Displacement Plan, Thriving in Place.
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on the Thriving in Place anti-displacement plan and deferred adoption to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 51 of 2023 Residential Parking Permit Program Amendment, amending Section 12.64.040 of Salt Lake City Code related to criteria for the Parking Permit Program.
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance allowing the transportation director to waive the minimum block-face requirement for parking permit areas near hospitals, universities, or TRAX stations, enabling a residential parking permit program in the Central Ninth neighborhood.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 52 of 2023 approving the American Rescue Plan Act (ARPA) Local Nonprofit Passthrough Assistance Grant Awards as shown in the Exhibit B Funding Log.
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance approving the disbursement of ARPA fiscal recovery funds as passthrough grants to local nonprofits benefiting small businesses and artists.
The Council approved all consent agenda items, including setting public hearing dates for three ordinances and approving multiple board appointments, reappointments, and term corrections.
